I was responsible for event collection, message processing, aggregation and page capture.

클릭 좌표 수집을 고치고, SQS 메시지를 Elasticsearch 문서: I fixed click-coordinate collection and built the processing that turns SQS messages into Elasticsearch documents, a refiner that prepares aggregates in advance, and a crawler that captures full pages.
기기마다 어긋나던 클릭 좌표를 바로잡고, 메시지 누락과 중복을 막았습니다: I corrected click coordinates that varied from device to device and stopped messages from being lost or duplicated. The analytics screens now read results the refiner has already prepared instead of aggregating in Elasticsearch every time, which fixed the timeouts.
수집기를 여러 컨테이너로 나눠 큐에 쌓인 메시지를 제때 가져가고, 같은: With the collector split across several containers, queued messages are picked up in time, and a message that arrives twice is still stored only once.
기기와 상관없이 맞는 히트맵: Heatmaps that are accurate on any device
좌표를 웹 요소 기준으로 기록해, 화면 크기가 달라도 같은 버튼의 클릭이: Coordinates are recorded relative to web elements, so clicks on the same button land in the same spot whatever the screen size.
무거운 집계를 미리 해 두어, 관리자가 화면을 열면 시간 초과 없이 그래: Heavy aggregation is done ahead of time, so administrators can open the screens and see charts and heatmaps without timeouts.
마우스 아래 맨 앞 요소를 기준으로 좌표 기록: Records coordinates relative to the topmost element under the mouse
SQS 메시지를 Elasticsearch 문서 양식으로 가공: Shapes SQS messages into the Elasticsearch document format
주기적으로 집계해 RDS 테이블에 저장: Aggregates periodically and stores the results in RDS tables
풀 페이지 스크롤 사이트도 전체 화면 캡처: Captures whole pages, even on full-page scrolling sites
페이지 절대 좌표로 기록해, 같은 버튼을 눌러도 화면 크기에 따라 다른: Clicks were recorded as absolute page coordinates, so the same button ended up at different positions depending on screen size.
마우스 아래 맨 앞에 있는 웹 요소를 찾아, 그 요소 안의 좌표로 기록했: I found the topmost web element under the mouse and recorded the coordinates within that element.
분석 화면을 열 때마다 Elasticsearch Aggregation으로: Aggregating with Elasticsearch Aggregation every time an analytics screen opened made responses so slow that they timed out.
주기적으로 집계해 RDS 테이블에 저장하는 정제기를 새로 만들어, 화면은: I built a new refiner that aggregates periodically and saves the results to RDS tables, so the screens only read finished aggregates.
관공서 사이트에 많던 섹션 단위 풀 페이지 스크롤에서는 일반 캡처로 첫: With the section-by-section full-page scrolling common on public-sector sites, a normal capture took only the first section.
Selenium API 대신 Chrome에 직접 요청을 보내, 캡처 높이: Instead of the Selenium API, I sent requests directly to Chrome, extended the capture height to the full scroll length and captured in mobile mode.
SQS 메시지를 1분 동안 가져가지 않으면 큐 한도를 넘어 데이터가 빠졌: If SQS messages were not picked up for a minute, the queue went over its limit and data was lost.
비동기 작업 큐로 여러 Docker 컨테이너에 수집 명령을 나눠, 메시지: Using an asynchronous task queue, I split collection commands across several Docker containers so messages are fetched in parallel.
Once fetching ran in parallel, the same message was sometimes fetched twice and logs were duplicated.
메시지 시간과 사용자 ID로 문서 ID를 만들어, 같은 메시지는 덮어쓰게: I built the document ID from the message time and user ID, so a repeated message overwrites the existing one.

DWG와 DXF, STEP와 STP의 차이: How do DWG and DXF, or STEP and STP, differ?
DWG와 DXF는 서로 다른 도면 파일 형식입니다. 도면을 주고받을 때는: DWG and DXF are different drawing file formats. When exchanging drawings, match the receiving application's supported format and save version, then reopen the result to check text, dimensions and external references.
STEP와 STP는 같은 STEP 형식에 쓰이는 확장자입니다. 다만 내보: STEP and STP are extensions used for the same STEP format. Export settings can affect geometry, assembly structure, colors and PMI. Renaming STP to STEP does not restore missing information.
SKP는 SketchUp 모델 파일입니다. 3D로 보인다고 해서 STEP: SKP is a SketchUp model file. A 3D display does not make it equivalent to STEP geometry, a production bill of materials or CNC machining code.
